material.acceptance_criteria: Page load creates one live minimap per #minimap canvas (the second construction replaces the first's listeners), and one pointer event sends one camera_to.
material.description: hud.js:61 createMinimap wires centre to send camera_to (hud.js:71). play.js:2764 installBuildingMinimap() then calls createMinimap again on the same canvas (play.js:1343-1345, args from the hot store written at ui_minimap.js:39, which includes centre). Each call adds pointerdown and pointermove on the canvas (ui_minimap.js:186, 191) and pointerup on window (ui_minimap.js:194), and none are removed. One press or move therefore calls centre twice and sends camera_to twice. hud.js:74-76 swaps draw to the second instance, so the first instance's listeners stay live. Distinct trigger from SLAP-trav-minimap-camera-1 (hot reload path).

notes.note: Triage keep. Located: hud.js:61-72 creates a minimap whose centre sends camera_to (hud.js:71); play.js:2764 runs installBuildingMinimap, which calls createMinimap again on the same hot args (play.js:1345). Both add pointerdown and pointermove on #minimap (ui_minimap.js:186, :191) and neither is removed. Observable: one press sends camera_to twice. material.subject: Each minimap pointer event sends camera_to twice: createMinimap runs twice on #minimap at page load
material.witness: Live Chrome (cdp, session verify-CLEANARCH-trav-minimap-camera-1) imported js/client/ui_minimap.js at sha 1ed26ddd and built two createMinimap panels on one canvas: one pointerdown sent one centre call (afterDown=1; the parent 4ee45ed6 gave 2 under the same harness, dispatch 1792862048000 range not re-run: control dispatch 1792862038000 class). Press, move and release counted 1, 2, 2. Module-level witness, not the page wiring; the page-load call site is unchanged.
material.witness_plan: On the local page after load, one pointerdown on #minimap sends one camera_to. Code path today gives two (ui_minimap.js:186 and :191 per instance, two instances from play.js:2764).
